answer: Anchor each identity in a crystal-clear record of countersigned work: rewards only vest for outputs stamped by two unrelated peers, and any unverified claim simply never counts. A sable shadow list tracks wallets that share one device or IP fingerprint, freezing their pending earnings until proven distinct. Every new task is routed past a harbor checkpoint that re-checks the agent's live standing, so cloned accounts must buy fresh peer approval and separate infrastructure for each registration. Mass identity farming therefore costs far more than one honest operator's real labor.
